description: Waits (up to ~45 s per call) for the user to resolve a pending Frapea prompt — e.g. the folder-permission dialog another tool just opened. The dialog waits for the user in the Frapea tab; the tool that opened it returned what they need to click. Returns {status: 'granted' | 'denied' | 'pending'}: 'pending' means they have not acted yet (call again to keep waiting), 'denied' that they declined.

actionId.description: The actionId a previous tool returned.

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: await_user_action
title: Wait for the user
